description: Send a nearby real human to a physical location for on-site verification, store/shelf/price checks, photos, queue checks or holding, or a pickup. This spends money and creates a real-world action: call errand_quote first, present its exact total_charge_krw, and obtain explicit user confirmation. The worker travels to the site, completes the instructions, and submits GPS/time-verified in-app evidence. Completed tasks pay the worker; failed, expired, or pre-acceptance cancelled tasks refund escrow.

address_hint.description: Human-readable place name/address shown to the worker.

instructions.description: Exactly what the worker should do on site, in the worker's language.

report_fields.description: Structured values the worker must report from the site (e.g. how many people are waiting). Returned in the result and included in the webhook.

label.description: Worker-facing prompt in Korean, e.g. "현재 대기 인원".

placeholder.description: Example answer shown in the empty field, e.g. "약 40".

unit.description: Unit shown beside the label, e.g. "명" or "분". Set it whenever the answer is a quantity: without it a worker asked for "예상 대기 시간" may reply "11" and you cannot tell minutes from people.

title.description: Short worker-facing title, e.g. "성수동 XYZ 팝업 대기줄 확인".

validation_criteria.description: What the photos must show for the evidence to pass, e.g. "매장 입구와 대기줄 전체가 한 프레임에 보여야 함".

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives mission.completed / mission.failed / mission.cancelled / mission.expired events, so you do not have to poll. Payload is advisory — confirm via errand_get_result.

name: errand_dispatch
title: Dispatch Human to Physical Location
